agio--tip.description: Agio, founded in the Netherlands in 1904 by Jacques Wintermans, makes the Tip as its namesake filter cigarillo: machine-made, 86 mm long, with a light shade-grown Java wrapper and binder over Indonesian and South American tobaccos and an activated-carbon filter. The smoke is smooth, light and slightly spicy; the Clair is softer still, and a sweet version exists.
